advancement.scythes.super_necromancer.de: Have ${balance:Progression.MINION_ARMY_SIZE|number} wither-skeleton minions at the same time.
tooltip.scythes.withering_minion.desc: Right click in the air summons a nearby wither-skeleton minion for ${balance:Withering.MINION_DURABILITY_COST|number} durability and ${balance:Withering.MINION_SOUL_COST|number} souls. Minions follow their owner, defend them, passively regenerate by consuming scythe durability, and vanish after ${balance:Minion.LIFETIME_TICKS|minutes} minutes. Shift+right click dismisses all of your minions. The base minion cap is ${balance:Withering.MAX_MINIONS|number} and can be increased with Additional Slot.
